title: Joining Networks
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: Two trees of N and M computers are given; the cost of a network is the sum, over all unordered pairs of its computers, of the squared number of edges between them. Exactly one new cable must join a computer of the first tree to a computer of the second. The task is to report the minimum possible cost of the combined network, with both sizes up to fifty thousand.
